checks: Independent installation used its own Node, native engine, local static assets and a fresh data directory. External socket access was denied.
A cold browser opened native Word, Excel, PPT, an Excalidraw board, PDF and PNG with no public asset requests. Two Word tabs synchronized via the bundled sidecar.

The installed offline workbench edited and reopened native pivots, conditional rules, OCR PDF text, image layers, PPTX master text styles and merged/split Word table cells using only its bundled assets.
A sealed candidate mutated its own migrated database and its sidecar exited. The controller restarted the previous release with the original dataset and the collaboration checkpoint intact.
A second release performed an actual schema upgrade on its new copy. A verified snapshot exists and both the original session and collaborative text remained usable.
Rollback switched the release and compatible data together. The newer dataset retained its writes, could be reactivated, and remained pinned after a controller restart.

nativeCases.name: pivots
checks: Created a cross-sheet pivot by dragging dimension fields, validated live formula-derived output, rejected an occupied destination and verified that result cells are read-only.
Recovered the workbook view on reload. A source edit updated a dependent formula and refreshed the report from 240 to 480.
Downloaded the original-format XLSX, reopened it in the workbench and changed the native PivotTable aggregation.

nativeCases.name: conditions
checks: Existing conditional rule appears in the editor and draws in the native grid canvas.
Edited imported rule, created a range rule, verified both fill colors, and reopened the rule editor after a page refresh.
Downloaded XLSX, opened it as a new tab, removed its native rule and restored it using revision undo; redo and a second undo immediately update the grid colors.

nativeCases.name: ocr
checks: PDF zoom changed the decoded raster from 816 to 1632 pixels at DPR 1.
A blocked-external-network browser recognized both scan-only pages using the bundled Chinese and English models.
The mixed page preserved its real header and the rotated crop retained upright Chinese and English line boxes.
OCR text was selected with the pointer, copied to the clipboard, corrected inline, saved, reloaded and searched.
The source-backed PDF was downloaded, uploaded as a fresh file, and searched by its native invisible OCR layer.

nativeCases.name: layers
checks: Workbench imported layers, moved and resized on-canvas, renamed, set opacity, drag-sorted and toggled visibility with saved revisions.
A concurrent stale layer mutation was rejected with HTTP 409.
Reload restored the layer selection and properties; a color adjustment saved as a reversible result layer.
Restoring a prior revision restored its layer order, metadata and raster together.
Downloaded the current composition in its original PNG format and reopened it as a new raster document; also downloaded the layer archive.

nativeCases.name: pptx
checks: A native PPTX inherits placeholder geometry by idx, master styles and theme Latin/CJK fonts. Text edits and pointer moves survive native export/reopen without changing shared layout, master or theme XML.

Inherited placeholders retain their positions and typography through a native master-background edit and a three-effect animation track; reload, presentation forward/back and native export/reopen preserve the track.

Edited title and body master text styles through the real dialog. Reload and native export/reopen retain shared font, size, color and explicit false values, while layout, paragraph and direct run overrides remain unchanged and title XML stays inherited.

nativeCases.name: word
checks: Word table menus merge horizontally and vertically, split back into editable cells, retain original paragraph order and marks, and accept real inline input without a modal.
Shift-click selects a complete 2×2 rectangle. Two real pages synchronize its merge, and guarded undo/redo leaves the other page’s later body edit intact.

The actual downloaded DOCX reopens in a new workbench file. Independent OOXML checks confirm native merges, split-cell input, bold/italic and every unrelated ZIP part; source content and the concurrent body edit survive.
